_comment: Windows 藍屏（bugcheck）代碼 → 名稱、常見原因、處置。資料自寫（參考 Microsoft Learn「Bug check code reference」公開說明），MIT。

zh: 驅動程式在高 IRQL 存取可分頁記憶體
記憶體（RAM）不穩定或超頻
en: A driver touched pageable memory at a raised IRQL
Unstable RAM or overclocking

fix.zh: 先更新或回復最近安裝／更新的驅動程式；仍發生就跑 Windows 記憶體診斷並關閉超頻（XMP）。
fix.en: Update or roll back recently installed/updated drivers; if it continues, run Windows Memory Diagnostic and disable overclocking (XMP).

zh: 驅動程式破壞了 kernel pool
防毒或磁碟加密等過濾驅動
en: A driver corrupted the kernel pool
Filter drivers such as antivirus or disk encryption

fix.zh: 更新防毒、VPN、磁碟工具等過濾驅動；開啟 Driver Verifier 找出元兇。
fix.en: Update filter drivers (antivirus, VPN, disk tools); use Driver Verifier to find the culprit.

zh: 記憶體硬體故障
驅動程式破壞記憶體管理結構
超頻／電壓不足
en: Faulty RAM
A driver corrupted memory-manager structures
Overclocking or undervolting

fix.zh: 跑 Windows 記憶體診斷或 MemTest86、逐條測試記憶體、恢復 BIOS 預設值。
fix.en: Run Windows Memory Diagnostic or MemTest86, test DIMMs one at a time, restore BIOS defaults.

zh: kernel 模式驅動程式發生未處理的例外
en: A kernel-mode driver raised an unhandled exception

fix.zh: 從 dump 找出出錯的驅動程式後更新或移除；sfc /scannow 檢查系統檔。
fix.en: Identify the faulting driver from the dump and update or remove it; run sfc /scannow.

zh: NTFS 檔案系統損毀
磁碟壞軌或連接線問題
en: NTFS corruption
Bad sectors or cabling problems

fix.zh: 執行 chkdsk /f /r、檢查磁碟 SMART 狀態、備份重要資料。
fix.en: Run chkdsk /f /r, check the disk's SMART status and back up important data.

zh: 系統服務呼叫時驅動程式出錯（常見：顯示卡、防毒、虛擬化驅動）
en: A driver failed during a system service call (often GPU, antivirus or virtualization drivers)

fix.zh: 更新顯示卡與防毒驅動；sfc /scannow 與 DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth。
fix.en: Update GPU and antivirus drivers; run sfc /scannow and DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth.

zh: 記憶體故障
驅動程式存取無效記憶體
防毒軟體
NTFS 損毀
en: Faulty RAM
A driver referenced invalid memory
Antivirus software
NTFS corruption

fix.zh: 測記憶體、更新最近變動的驅動程式、執行 chkdsk。
fix.en: Test RAM, update recently changed drivers, run chkdsk.

zh: 從磁碟讀回分頁失敗：硬碟／SSD 壞軌、連接線或控制器問題
分頁檔損毀
en: Reading a page back from disk failed: bad sectors, cabling or controller issues
Corrupted page file

fix.zh: 立即備份；檢查磁碟 SMART、更換 SATA 線、更新儲存控制器驅動與 SSD 韌體。
fix.en: Back up now; check SMART, replace SATA cables, update storage controller drivers and SSD firmware.

zh: 開機時找不到系統磁碟：BIOS 改了 SATA 模式（AHCI／RAID）、儲存驅動損毀、磁碟故障
en: The boot disk is unreachable: SATA mode changed in BIOS (AHCI/RAID), broken storage driver, disk failure

fix.zh: 把 BIOS 儲存模式改回原設定；用 Windows 修復環境修復開機。
fix.en: Revert the BIOS storage mode; repair startup from the Windows Recovery Environment.

zh: 系統執行緒裡的驅動程式例外（顯示卡、網路、儲存驅動最常見）
en: A driver raised an exception in a system thread (GPU, network and storage drivers are the usual suspects)

fix.zh: dump 的 faulting module 就是元兇：更新或回復該驅動程式。
fix.en: The faulting module in the dump is the culprit: update or roll back that driver.

zh: CPU 硬體例外：過熱、超頻、記憶體或主機板問題
en: A CPU hardware trap: overheating, overclocking, RAM or motherboard problems

fix.zh: 恢復 BIOS 預設、檢查散熱與溫度、測記憶體。
fix.en: Restore BIOS defaults, check cooling and temperatures, test RAM.

zh: 硬體送出不可遮蔽中斷（記憶體同位錯誤、匯流排錯誤）
en: Hardware raised a non-maskable interrupt (memory parity or bus errors)

fix.zh: 檢查硬體：記憶體、擴充卡、電源供應器；伺服器看 IPMI／iLO 紀錄。
fix.en: Check hardware: RAM, expansion cards, PSU; on servers review IPMI/iLO logs.

zh: CPU 回報的機器檢查例外（硬體錯誤）
en: A machine-check exception reported by the CPU (hardware error)

fix.zh: 恢復 BIOS 預設、更新 BIOS、檢查溫度與電壓。
fix.en: Restore BIOS defaults, update the BIOS, check temperatures and voltages.

zh: 驅動程式處理睡眠／休眠／喚醒時卡住（網路卡、顯示卡、晶片組、USB 驅動常見）
en: A driver hung while handling sleep, hibernate or resume (network, GPU, chipset or USB drivers)

fix.zh: 更新晶片組、網路與顯示卡驅動；暫時關閉「快速啟動」與 USB 選擇性暫停。
fix.en: Update chipset, network and GPU drivers; temporarily disable Fast Startup and USB selective suspend.

zh: 驅動程式寫入唯讀記憶體
en: A driver wrote to read-only memory

fix.zh: 更新或移除最近安裝的驅動程式。
fix.en: Update or remove recently installed drivers.

zh: 驅動程式送出錯誤的記憶體配置要求
en: A driver made a bad pool allocation request

fix.zh: 更新防毒、VPN 與硬體驅動；用 Driver Verifier 找出元兇。
fix.en: Update antivirus, VPN and hardware drivers; use Driver Verifier to find the culprit.

zh: 驅動程式破壞系統記憶體池
en: A driver corrupted the system pool

fix.zh: 更新或移除最近變動的驅動程式。
fix.en: Update or remove recently changed drivers.

zh: 驅動程式在過高 IRQL 存取可分頁記憶體（網路卡、無線網卡、儲存驅動最常見）
en: A driver accessed pageable memory at too high an IRQL (network, Wi-Fi and storage drivers are common)

fix.zh: dump 會指出驅動程式檔名（例：xxx.sys）：更新或回復它。
fix.en: The dump names the driver file (e.g. xxx.sys): update or roll it back.

zh: 使用者或管理員刻意觸發（鍵盤組合鍵或 NMI 按鈕）
en: Deliberately triggered by a user or admin (keyboard combo or NMI button)

fix.zh: 通常是為了收集 dump 排查卡死；確認是誰觸發的即可。
fix.en: Usually done to capture a dump of a hang; just confirm who triggered it.

zh: 顯示卡驅動卡在迴圈等待硬體（顯示卡、過熱、電源）
en: A GPU driver is stuck waiting on hardware (GPU, overheating, power)

fix.zh: 更新或乾淨重灌顯示卡驅動、檢查顯示卡溫度與電源。
fix.en: Update or clean-install the GPU driver; check GPU temperature and power.

zh: 關鍵系統行程（csrss、wininit、smss…）結束：系統檔損毀、磁碟錯誤、惡意程式
en: A critical system process (csrss, wininit, smss…) exited: corrupted system files, disk errors, malware

fix.zh: sfc /scannow、DISM /RestoreHealth、chkdsk；並做一次完整防毒掃描。
fix.en: Run sfc /scannow, DISM /RestoreHealth and chkdsk, plus a full antivirus scan.

zh: 關鍵行程或執行緒意外結束：磁碟故障最常見，也可能是惡意程式
en: A critical process or thread ended unexpectedly: disk failure is most common; malware is possible

fix.zh: 檢查磁碟 SMART 與連接線、跑 chkdsk、完整防毒掃描。
fix.en: Check SMART and cables, run chkdsk and a full antivirus scan.

zh: 嘗試執行不可執行的記憶體：驅動程式錯誤或惡意程式
en: Code tried to run non-executable memory: a driver bug or malware

fix.zh: 更新驅動程式並做完整防毒掃描。
fix.en: Update drivers and run a full antivirus scan.

zh: 某個 CPU 核心沒有回應：超頻、BIOS、CPU 或主機板問題
en: A CPU core stopped responding: overclocking, BIOS, CPU or motherboard problems

fix.zh: 恢復 BIOS 預設並更新 BIOS、取消超頻、檢查散熱。
fix.en: Restore and update the BIOS, remove overclocks, check cooling.

zh: 顯示卡驅動逾時且無法復原：驅動問題、顯示卡過熱、電源不足
en: The display driver timed out and could not recover: driver issue, GPU overheating, insufficient power

fix.zh: 用 DDU 乾淨重灌顯示卡驅動、檢查溫度與電源、取消顯示卡超頻。
fix.en: Clean-install the GPU driver (DDU), check temperatures and power, remove GPU overclocks.

zh: 顯示卡驅動逾時（通常會自動復原；反覆出現代表驅動或硬體問題）
en: The display driver timed out (usually recovers; repeats point to driver or hardware problems)

fix.zh: 更新顯示卡驅動、檢查溫度與電源。
fix.en: Update the GPU driver; check temperatures and power.

zh: 顯示卡排程器發生嚴重錯誤（多半是顯示卡驅動）
en: The GPU scheduler hit a fatal error (usually the GPU driver)

fix.zh: 更新或回復顯示卡驅動。
fix.en: Update or roll back the GPU driver.

zh: 硬體回報無法修正的錯誤：CPU、記憶體、超頻／電壓、電源、過熱
en: Hardware reported an uncorrectable error: CPU, RAM, overclocking/voltage, PSU, overheating

fix.zh: 看同時間的 WHEA-Logger 事件判斷是哪個元件；恢復 BIOS 預設、取消超頻、檢查溫度與電源。
fix.en: Check WHEA-Logger events from the same time to find the component; restore BIOS defaults, remove overclocks, check temperatures and the PSU.

zh: 驅動程式 DPC 執行太久：SSD 韌體或 storahci 驅動最常見，也可能是網路或顯示卡驅動
en: A driver DPC ran too long: SSD firmware or the storahci driver most often, sometimes network or GPU drivers

fix.zh: 更新 SSD 韌體與儲存控制器驅動（晶片組驅動）、更新網路與顯示卡驅動。
fix.en: Update SSD firmware and storage controller (chipset) drivers, then network and GPU drivers.

zh: kernel 偵測到資料結構被破壞：驅動程式錯誤或記憶體損壞
en: The kernel detected corrupted data structures: a driver bug or memory corruption

fix.zh: 更新驅動程式、測記憶體、sfc /scannow。
fix.en: Update drivers, test RAM, run sfc /scannow.

zh: 驅動程式破壞 kernel heap（常見：顯示卡、音效、防毒驅動）
en: A driver corrupted the kernel heap (GPU, audio or antivirus drivers are common)

fix.zh: 更新或回復最近變動的驅動程式。
fix.en: Update or roll back recently changed drivers.

zh: USB 3 控制器驅動或 USB 裝置問題
en: USB 3 controller driver or USB device problem

fix.zh: 拔掉 USB 裝置逐一測試、更新晶片組與 USB 控制器驅動。
fix.en: Unplug USB devices one by one; update chipset and USB controller drivers.

zh: 記憶體壓縮存放區例外：磁碟／SSD 韌體或記憶體問題
en: Memory compression store exception: disk/SSD firmware or RAM problems

fix.zh: 更新 SSD 韌體、檢查 SMART、測記憶體。
fix.en: Update SSD firmware, check SMART, test RAM.

zh: 虛擬機器或系統長時間沒有回應（常見於 Hyper-V／虛擬化環境資源不足）
en: The VM or system stopped responding for too long (common under Hyper-V / virtualization resource pressure)

fix.zh: 檢查主機資源與虛擬化驅動、更新整合服務。
fix.en: Check host resources and virtualization drivers; update integration services.
